 root,path=case shape;when 'dict';['{"inner":'+leaf+'}','state["inner"]'];when 'struct';['Holder { row:'+leaf+' }','state.row'];else;['{"inner":{"leaf":'+leaf+'}}','state["inner"]["leaf"]'];end

 owner="mut state:=#{root}\nexport func snapshot() { return #{path} }\nexport func update(n) { #{writes} return n }\n"

 count=form=='arrays' ? 2 : 3
 main="from owner import snapshot,update\nlet original:=snapshot() mut n:=1 while n<=#{calls} { #{before} assert_equal(update(n),n) #{check} n+=1 }\nlet final:=snapshot() assert_equal(len(final),#{width}) #{checks.call('final',calls)} mut k:=0 while k<#{width} { assert_equal(original[k],0) if k>=#{count} { assert_equal(final[k],0) } k+=1 } print(\"NESTED DICTIONARY PAYLOAD PASS\")\n"
 File.write(dir+'/owner.kujo',owner);File.write(dir+'/main.kujo',main);[dir+'/owner.kujo',dir+'/main.kujo'].each{|p|r[:sources][p]={sha256:sha.call(p),source:File.read(p)}}
 meta={shape:shape,form:form,width:width,snapshot:snapshot,calls:calls,path:dir+'/main.kujo'}
 %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
  argv=[prior+'/task-allocation-probe',mode,meta[:path]];out,err,s=Open3.capture3(*argv);m=err.match(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/);raise out+err unless s.success?&&m&&out=="NESTED DICTIONARY PAYLOAD PASS\n"
  r[:rows]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:argv,stdout:out,stderr:err,exit:s.exitstatus,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i)
 end

r['identities'].each{|p,h|raise 'identity' unless sha.call(p)==h};r['sources'].each{|p,v|raise 'source' unless sha.call(p)==v['sha256']}
cases=%w[dict struct deep-dict].product(%w[arrays mixed],[8,2048],%w[once fresh],[1,8,16])
%w[rows semantics].each do |kind|
 modes=kind=='rows' ? %w[vm jit] : %w[vm interpreter jit]
 raise 'coverage' unless r[kind].map{|x|x.values_at('shape','form','width','snapshot','calls','mode')}==cases.flat_map{|c|modes.map{|m|c+[m]}}
 r[kind].each do |x|
  raise 'result' unless x['exit']==0&&x['stdout']=="NESTED DICTIONARY PAYLOAD PASS\n"&&x['argv'].include?(x['path'])
  if kind=='rows';raise 'counter' unless x['stderr'].scan(/requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)==[[x['requests'].to_s,x['bytes'].to_s]];end
 end
end
slopes=r['rows'].group_by{|x|x.values_at('shape','form','width','snapshot','mode')}.map do |k,v|
 a=v.find{|x|x['calls']==8};b=v.find{|x|x['calls']==16};{group:k,bytes_per_call:(b['bytes']-a['bytes']).fdiv(8),requests_per_call:(b['requests']-a['requests']).fdiv(8)}
end
widths=slopes.select{|s|s[:group][3]=='once'}.group_by{|s|s[:group].values_at(0,1,4)}.map do |k,v|
 small=v.find{|s|s[:group][2]==8};large=v.find{|s|s[:group][2]==2048};{group:k,small:small[:bytes_per_call],large:large[:bytes_per_call],width_penalty:large[:bytes_per_call]-small[:bytes_per_call]}
end
File.write(o+'/verified.json',JSON.pretty_generate({status:'verified',runtime:'b1bf786',allocations:144,semantic_runs:216,slopes:slopes,width_effects:widths,report_sha256:sha.call(o+'/report.json')})+"\n")
puts JSON.pretty_generate(widths)
